title: Remove caffeine.ai watermark/branding and avoid caffeine.ai in displayed URLs

requirements.text: Remove all visible caffeine.ai watermark/branding from the website UI, including the footer referral link and any other user-facing mentions of caffeine.ai.

quotes: just remove the water mark of caffine.ai

acceptanceCriteria: The AppShell footer no longer displays the text/link "caffeine.ai" and does not link to caffeine.ai.
No other user-facing UI text (header/footer/pages) contains "caffeine.ai" (case-insensitive).
The app continues to build and render normally after removing the branding.

requirements.text: Remove any hardcoded caffeine.ai URL usage from the frontend and replace it with neutral/non-branded behavior (e.g., no external branding link), and update documentation to explain how to use a shorter/custom domain for the deployed site (without referencing caffeine.ai).

quotes: change the url of  website to something smaller and remove caffine.ai from url

acceptanceCriteria: There are no hardcoded links to "https://caffeine.ai" in the frontend codebase.

Frontend docs/README include a short section describing that the deployed app URL is determined by the IC deployment/canister and that a shorter/custom domain requires external DNS/domain configuration steps (described at a high level) without mentioning caffeine.ai.
All new/updated user-facing documentation text is in English.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only components must be composed, not edited).
Do not claim to change the actual hosted domain purely via frontend/backend code; only remove caffeine.ai references and document how to use a custom/short domain externally.
nonGoals: Purchasing/registering a domain, configuring DNS records, or setting up boundary node/domain routing on the user’s behalf.
Adding new product features unrelated to removing caffeine.ai branding or documenting custom domain usage.
